steps.what: Develop corporate fundraising programs such as employer matching
Refuse a match the employer program does not already state

tasks.design: The fundraiser develops corporate fundraising programs, such as employer gift-matching. Developing the program stays at full effort. A stored rate is not applied by a rule. The fundraiser decides whether a match fits. Employees are not scored.
tasks.previous_blocker: The fundraiser designed the matching program.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a gift matches stays with the fundraiser.
tasks.human_edge: The fundraiser does not grant a match the employer program does not state.
tasks.altitude: The program design stays at full effort. A match is not granted by a rule.

reach.task: Confirm the program the fundraiser will use

evidence.claim: Developing an employer matching program stays a judgement. A match is not granted by a rule.

assumptions: The brief is the employer program the fundraiser already holds, including any rate the employer wrote.
A blank rate is left blank and is not invented. Employees are not scored. Upkeep is zero.
Recording the gift is a different task.
unknowns: Which of these conversations the fundraiser will not delegate.
research_questions: How often did the fundraiser stop rather than ask?

already_counted.description: This conversation is already in the fundraiser's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the conversation adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every program is still developed by the fundraiser. High: the same design remains, with no match granted by a rule. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Coordinate transportation or delivery of materials and supplies
Move donations for fundraising events in person

tasks.design: The fundraiser coordinates transportation or delivery of materials, supplies, or donations for fundraising events. The physical work stays at full effort. Nothing in {OPS_SYSTEM} moves a box.
tasks.previous_blocker: The fundraiser arranged the delivery and moved what had to be moved.
tasks.still_hard: What moves, and how, stays with the fundraiser.
tasks.human_edge: The fundraiser stops when the load is not the one the event needs.
tasks.altitude: The delivery stays at full effort.

reach.task: Carry only what the fundraiser names

evidence.claim: Coordinating delivery of materials or donations stays physical work.

assumptions: The brief is the donor, event, or cause the fundraiser already holds. A blank name is left blank.
No score is stored for a donor, a volunteer, or a member of staff. Upkeep is zero.
An ask for a gift is a different conversation from filing a record.
unknowns: Which of these conversations the fundraiser will not delegate.

already_counted.description: This conversation is already in the fundraiser's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the conversation adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every delivery is still coordinated by the fundraiser. High: the same physical work remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.short: Develop and maintain media contact lists

steps.what: Develop media contact lists from named people
Review that media contact before the list changes
Maintain media contact lists with the accepted name

tasks.design: The fundraiser develops and maintains media contact lists. Choosing who belongs on the list stays at full effort. {CRM} stores only the contact the fundraiser has accepted. A blank name stays blank. Journalists are not scored. The store does not send them a message.
tasks.previous_blocker: The fundraiser kept the list by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted contact can be stored. Choosing the person stays manual.
tasks.still_hard: Who belongs on the list stays with the fundraiser.
tasks.human_edge: The fundraiser does not store a name they have not checked.
tasks.altitude: The list changes only after the fundraiser accepts that contact. Nobody is messaged from this step.

reach.task: See only a contact the fundraiser accepted

evidence.claim: An accepted media contact can be stored. Choosing who is on the list stays manual. Nobody is scored or messaged from the store.

assumptions: The work starts with an introduction and ends when the accepted contact is stored, or the fundraiser stops.
A contact draft has name and outlet, written by the fundraiser. A blank name is left blank and is not invented.
The store uses the contact accepted in the review. It does not send a message.
unknowns: Which outlets the fundraiser will not list.
research_questions: How often did a blank name stop the store?

already_counted.description: Developing the contact list is already in the fundraiser's step.

incremental.description: Correct a name before the contact is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: names are often still unchecked, so the fundraiser still builds the list. High: names are checked, the fundraiser reviews them, and only the accepted contact is stored. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The fundraiser still asks, bargains, and chooses the donor. A thank-you, a grant file, or a report is sent or stored only after the fundraiser accepts that version.
reach: A donor receives only a thank-you the fundraiser has accepted.
A funding organisation receives only materials the fundraiser has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a gift, amount, or name is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a send.
Keep the ask, the commitment, and the strategy in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every thank-you traces to a stored gift, and the fundraiser still writes the sentence.
